authorship.author: Separate evaluation and review agents in a shared development workspace
authorship.independence: Counterexample matrix proposed before reading the implementation; test code written and reviewed while implementation was available. The implementation and tests were revised during shared review. This is not blinded or held-out evaluation and not external human review.
authorship.oracle: Declared authority boundaries and concrete counterexamples; not a copied production recurrence. The separate finite conformance file compares the gate.
authorship.provenance_boundary: Source origins, ancestry and active states are declarations. No acquisition identity, historical preregistration, unseen reference or physical observation was authenticated.
authorship.review_history: Review hardened world-bridge and provenance/scope guards, propagated resource exhaustion, separated context checks from claim checks, and kept contested-premise derivations out of clean refutation. Provisional DEFER/UNREVIEWED oracle labels were aligned with the final explicit law. Subsequent independent review found a real CLI report-size round-trip defect; v1 evidence is retained as pre-fix history. Discovery includes the separately authored report-budget regressions and freeze tests.
